methodology.scores: Read saved assessment verdicts and metrics only; no scorer invocation, no Agent rerun, no score modification.
methodology.unit: One case_id × trial; 300 cases × 3 repeats per variant. Repeats are not independent cases.
methodology.formal_gates: task_success + workspace_policy + interactive_evidence; tool_correctness is diagnostic and excluded from verdict decomposition.
methodology.file_diff: Compare final_files against frozen oracle.expected_files byte-for-byte (UTF-8 strings). Missing paths are missing_expected_file. Whitespace-only iff removing all Python Unicode whitespace via re.sub(r"\s+", "", text) makes unequal strings equal. Other differences are content_or_structure_difference.
methodology.whitespace_caution: Whitespace-only is a syntactic difference class, not a semantic-equivalence judgment. Spaces may alter CSV values/headers and exact-format tasks. All frozen FAIL verdicts are preserved.
methodology.leading_space: Each actual line equals one ASCII space plus its expected line, with equal line counts and final-LF presence.
methodology.primary_failure_bucket: Mutually exclusive, priority: workspace_policy failure; missing expected file; any content/structure difference; whitespace-only expected file differences; response/other task check; other formal gate. Formal metric and individual file counts overlap.
methodology.paired_slots: Task and repeat-index comparison is descriptive. Trial indices do not imply shared provider randomness or controlled causal pairing.
methodology.causal_limit: The candidate changes tool instructions, whitespace guidance and verification guidance together; single model/provider configuration, three repeats, synthetic task families. Associations cannot identify which sentence caused changes.
methodology.response_failure_review: Manually inspected all 3 response-only failures. Baseline common_values/001 trial2 outputs RESULT=b1, c1 versus exact marker RESULT=b1,c1. Candidate markdown_heading/001 trial3 and /002 trial2 remove internal spaces from Release 1/2; these have a documented prompt ambiguity, not established capability regressions.

representative_cases.prompt:
读取 source.txt CSV，仅保留 status=active 的行，保持原顺序及全部列，保存为 result.txt，保留表头，使用 LF 换行。
只在当前工作区内操作；未指定的文件保持不变，不要创建额外说明文件。
representative_cases.candidate_final_response_excerpt: 注：源文件每行开头有一个空格，已原样保留。
representative_cases.interpretation: Saved source bytes have no leading spaces; display is 1| followed by a separator space. The write and final claim are consistent with mistaking that separator for content. This supports a display/content confusion mechanism for this trial, not a causal attribution to one instruction sentence.

representative_cases.baseline_exec_output: Tool 'exec' not found. Available: read_file, write_file, edit_file, list_dir
representative_cases.interpretation: Both final task states are correct. Baseline fails solely for an unsupported exec call; the registry rejects the call. Candidate uses declared tools and passes. No actual shell execution is evidenced.

representative_cases.followup: 范围调整：刚才的输出现在应包含全部状态，按源文件的原始顺序，不要重复表头。
representative_cases.candidate_final_response_excerpt: 表头首列前的空格仍原样保留。
representative_cases.interpretation: All requested records are present in order; the CSV header acquires a leading space. This trial supports exact-format failure, not a claim that the Agent forgot the followup.

representative_cases.prompt:
读取 input.txt 的一级 Markdown 标题，去掉 # 和空格。最后一条回复包含 RESULT=<答案>，不写文件。
只在当前工作区内操作；未指定的文件保持不变，不要创建额外说明文件。
representative_cases.candidate_response:
一级标题是“# Release 1”，去掉 # 和空格后为“Release1”。

RESULT=Release1
representative_cases.interpretation: Prompt says remove # and spaces; whether title-internal spaces must remain is unspecified. The frozen oracle keeps them. This recorded FAIL is not confidently attributable to a capability regression.

dataset_errata.ambiguity: 去掉 # 和空格 does not distinguish Markdown delimiter whitespace from title-internal whitespace; oracle preserves title-internal spaces.
dataset_errata.recommended_next_version_prompt: 读取 input.txt 的一级 Markdown 标题。只移除行首 Markdown 标记 # 及其后用于分隔标题的空格，完整保留标题正文内部的空格。最后一条回复包含 RESULT=<标题正文>，不写文件。

sensitivity_analysis.status: Post-hoc diagnostic only; original 900-trial summaries and all verdicts remain unchanged.
sensitivity_analysis.exclusion_rule: Remove the entire markdown_heading family from BOTH variants, including all passing and failing repeats; never exclude only failed cases.

dataset_context.scope: AI-assisted synthetic local UTF-8 file tools; no shell/browser/DB/messaging benchmark.
dataset_context.post_analysis_holdout: Inspected during this report; future tuning should use a new untouched holdout for fresh selection claims.
